name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo xargs -r -a packages.txt apt-get install -y; fi && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install --user -r requirements.txt; fi

postAttachCommand.server: python3 -m streamlit run app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
